note: Sources bench/loader_api.py reads besides the mined Stonecutter mods (coverage/stonecutter/mods.json). Each is a project that implements one interface once per loader, pinned to a commit. Only its text is read; nothing from it is copied into this repository except the names of the loader calls it makes.

sources.why: One common API with a Fabric, a Forge and a NeoForge implementation of every method: the same method name in fabric/ and neoforge/ is the same job on each loader.
